summary: Hines Global Income Trust filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of May 31, 2026. The filing details the NAV calculation methodology, board valuation committee oversight, and third-party appraisal reviews by Altus Group. It is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation. No transaction, change of control, or material corporate event is announced.
